page.title: Changelog
page.description: Release notes for the Adobe Express Embed SDK, with the newest release first.

groups.label: SDK v1–v3
groups.hint: Releases before v4 aren't tagged by module or type.

changes.text: [`module.createGuidedDesign`](../../v4/sdk/src/workflows/3p/module-workflow/classes/module-workflow#createguideddesign) module that launches a guided design creation flow in EDE.
[`EditFurtherIntent.ERASE`](../../v4/shared/src/types/export-config-types/enumerations/edit-further-intent) starting intent for Edit Image, so users can continue into object erase.
Various performance improvements and fixes.
Per-document success/failure status in [`migrateAssets()`](../../v4/sdk/src/workflows/3p/module-workflow/classes/module-workflow#migrateassets) `MigrateAssetsResult`.

Optional `tooltip` field on [`PublishExportOption`](../../v4/shared/src/types/export-config-types/interfaces/publish-export-option#properties) in `ExportConfig`, letting hosts customize hover tooltip text on publish-target export buttons.

[Embedded Design Editor (EDE) concept guide](../concepts/ede) introducing EDE's configurable, focused creation experiences, along with companion [Create Design](../concepts/ede-create-design) and [Edit Design](../concepts/ede-edit-design) guides.
[Embedded Design Editor tutorial](../tutorials/embedded-design-editor) walking through building a Create Design → Edit Design flow step by step.

[`migrateAssets()`](../../v4/sdk/src/workflows/3p/module-workflow/classes/module-workflow#migrateassets) support for asset migration (guest to logged-in user) in the [Partner Assertion](../../v4/shared/src/types/authentication-types/#interfaces) workflow.

[`DesignViewerContext`](../../v4/sdk/src/context/3p/design-viewer-context/classes/design-viewer-context) access for Design Viewer, allowing host applications to provide additional assets after initial load via [`updateDesignAssets`](../../v4/sdk/src/context/3p/design-viewer-context/classes/design-viewer-context#updatedesignassets).

[`hideTemplatePreview`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/browse-mode-config#properties) option to hide Template Preview, navigating directly to the editor after selecting a template.
[`editorGuideConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/editor-guide-config) property to configure visibility of Bleed, Margins, and Rulers in the Edit Design module UI.

[`pdfPrintConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/pdf-print-config) property to configure print-ready PDF export in the Edit Design module (`"print"` variant), including Crop Marks, Bleed, Color Mode, and ICC Profile.
`createDesign()` with `"print"` variant now correctly displays bleed in the editor preview.
[Analytics concept guide](../concepts/host-app-trigger) explaining how to configure required analytics data for consistent launch attribution across Embed SDK workflows.
[`PartnerAssertionAuthConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/authentication-types/#type-aliases) interface for partner assertion authentication (guest, signed-in, or guest-to-user transition).

[`PublishAction.previewConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/export-config-types/interfaces/publish-action#properties) property of type [`AssetPreviewConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/export-config-types/interfaces/asset-preview-config) to configure an additional output preview image.
[`CCEverywhere.DesignViewerDocConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/doc-config-types/interfaces/design-viewer-doc-config) accepts multiple assets in `docConfig`.

[`CCEverywhere.EditorAppConfig.editorMode`](../../v4/shared/src/types/editor/app-config-types/interfaces/base-editor-app-config#properties) optional property on Full Editor `appConfig`; setting `'assistant'` opens the editor with the AI Assistant panel active.
[Template Browser v2 concept guide](../concepts/template-browser-v2) covering the new tabbed Template Browser experience for authenticated users (coexists with Template Browser v1).
General improvements and bug fixes.
[Design Viewer concept guide](../concepts/design-viewer) covering implementation details of the Design Viewer module.

[`CCEverywhere.viewDesign`](../../v4/sdk/src/workflows/3p/module-workflow/classes/module-workflow#viewdesign) Design Viewer module, configured via [`DesignViewerAppConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/design-viewer-app-config) and [`DesignViewerDocConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/doc-config-types/interfaces/design-viewer-doc-config).

Expanded **Mobile Web Concept Guide**: [Overview](../concepts/mobile-web-support-overview) comparing Mobile Web and Mobile SDKs, [Mobile Web in a WebView](../concepts/mobile-web-support-webview) for iOS and Android apps, and improved information architecture.
[Mobile Web tutorial](../tutorials/mobile-web) with a Fantasy Sports badge creation end-to-end example and working samples for Web (client and server), Android, and iOS.
[`CCEverywhere.PublishAction.outputType`](../../v4/shared/src/types/export-config-types/interfaces/publish-action) option to return output files as `Blob` for Quick Actions and Module Workflows.
[`CCEverywhere.PublishConfig.outputType`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/publish-config#properties) asset data type updated for `Blob` output.
[`CCEverywhere.BaseAppConfig.metaData`](../../v4/shared/src/types/design-config-types/interfaces/base-app-config#properties) support for passing custom key-value metadata across all workflows.
[Template Browser concept guide](../concepts/template-browser) covering implementation details of the Template Browser experience.

[`CCEverywhere.BaseAppConfig.useClientAuth`](../../v4/shared/src/types/design-config-types/interfaces/base-app-config#properties) option for credit-free Generative AI workflows in Generate Image and Edit Image (enabled partners only).

[`CCEverywhere.CallBackTarget.CALLBACK`](../../v4/shared/src/types/export-config-types/enumerations/call-back-target#callback) export target to trigger callback actions without publishing or downloading assets.

**Custom Message Workflow**: [`WORKFLOW_CONTEXT`](../../v4/shared/src/messenger/message-types/enumerations/message-type#workflow_context) message type, [`CustomMessage`](../../v4/shared/src/messenger/message-types/interfaces/custom-message) interface (instance ID, request ID, action, intent, and optional data), and [`CustomMessageAction`](../../v4/shared/src/messenger/message-types/enumerations/custom-message-action) enum for unsaved changes and asset requests.

[`CCEverywhere.ModalContainerConfig.showExpressIconWithText`](../../v4/shared/src/types/container-config-types/interfaces/modal-container-config#properties) default loading screen includes the Express logo and text.

[`CCEverywhere.BaseEditorAppConfig.canvasBackgroundColor`](../../v4/shared/src/types/editor/app-config-types/interfaces/base-editor-app-config#properties) option to configure canvas background color in `RRGGBBAA` HEX format.

[`CCEverywhere.ModuleWorkflow.CancelCallback`](../../v4/shared/src/types/callbacks-types/type-aliases/cancel-callback) `onCancel` reports optional `isEscapePressed` (`true` when canceled via Escape during loading).

[`CCEverywhere.HostInfo.coiEnabled`](../../v4/shared/src/types/host-info-types/interfaces/host-info-specified-base#properties) property on `HostInfo` indicating whether COI (Cross-Origin Isolation) is enabled.
[`CCEverywhere.BaseContainerConfig.iframeTitle`](../../v4/shared/src/types/container-config-types/interfaces/base-container-config#properties) property to configure the iframe's accessible title.

[`CCEverywhere.BrowseSearchBaseConfig.rootCollectionId`](../../v4/shared/src/types/browse-search-config-types/interfaces/browse-search-base-config#properties) option to surface non-Express collections in the browser.
[Mobile Web Support Overview](../concepts/mobile-web-support-overview) concept guide covering mobile creative workflows, configuration options, best practices, and troubleshooting.

[Workflow Tethering concept guide](../concepts/tethering) and [Workflow Tethering tutorial](../tutorials/workflow-tethering) covering chained workflows (Generate Image → Edit Image and Edit Image → Full Editor).
`AUTO` content type on [`ImageContentType`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/enumerations/image-content-type) to automatically determine content type from the prompt and context.
`ImageColorStyle`, `ImageCompositionStyle`, and `ImageLightingStyle` enumerations are no longer accepted in `CCEverywhere.TextToImageAppConfig.panelSettings`.
changes.action: Remove these values from your `panelSettings` configuration.

changes.text: [Edit Image tutorial](../tutorials/edit-image) covering implementation details of Edit Image v2 features.

[`CCEverywhere.TextToImageAppConfig.panelSettings`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#panelsettings) configuration for Generate Image v1 and v2, including [`PanelSettings`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/interfaces/panel-settings), [`StyleSetting`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/interfaces/style-setting), and [`ContentTypeSetting`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/interfaces/content-type-setting).

Style enumerations and [`ImageStyleId`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/type-aliases/image-style-id): [`ImageContentType`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/enumerations/image-content-type), [`ImageThemeStyle`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/enumerations/image-theme-style), [`ImageTechniqueStyle`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/enumerations/image-technique-style), `ImageLightingStyle`, `ImageCompositionStyle`, [`ImageEffectStyle`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/enumerations/image-effect-style), `ImageColorStyle`, [`ImageMovementStyle`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/enumerations/image-movement-style), [`ImageMaterialStyle`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/enumerations/image-material-style), and [`ImageConceptStyle`](../../v4/shared/src/types/panel-settings-types/enumerations/image-concept-style).

[`CCEverywhere.TextToImageAppConfig.hideFeedbackMenu`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#hidefeedbackmenu) option to hide the feedback menu in the header bar.
[`CCEverywhere.TextToImageAppConfig.isPromptSafe`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#ispromptsafe) callback for custom prompt moderation.

[`CCEverywhere.TextToImageAppConfig.promptInputPlaceholder`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#promptinputplaceholder) placeholder text configuration for the prompt input field (Generate Image v2 only).
Updated [Generate Image tutorial](../tutorials/generate-image) and [Concept Guide](../concepts/generate-image-v2) for the new panel settings options.
[`CCEverywhere.EditImageAppConfig.inlineTOUConsent`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/edit-image-app-config#inlinetouconsent) inline Terms of Use consent configuration.
[`PublishButtonGroup`](../../v4/shared/src/types/export-config-types/interfaces/publish-button-group) interface for organizing export buttons.
[Generate Image tutorial](../tutorials/generate-image) covering Generate Image v2 features, including the Custom Community Wall.
Improved API Reference (v4) documentation for Type Aliases such as [`Asset`](../../v4/shared/src/types/asset-types/type-aliases/asset).

[`CCEverywhere.module.editImage()`](../../v4/sdk/src/workflows/3p/module-workflow/classes/module-workflow) [Edit Image v2 experience](../concepts/edit-image-v2): 35–50% faster loads, 35% less memory, Adobe Spectrum 2 UI. No config changes needed.

[`CCEverywhere.TextToImageAppConfig.communityWallConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties) to populate the Community Wall with custom images (see [Custom Community Wall](../concepts/generate-image-v2#custom-community-wall)).

[`CCEverywhere.EditorAppConfig.showPageMargin`](../../v4/shared/src/types/editor/app-config-types/interfaces/base-editor-app-config#properties) and [`CCEverywhere.EditorAppConfig.showBleedArea`](../../v4/shared/src/types/editor/app-config-types/interfaces/base-editor-app-config#properties) options to control margins and bleed visibility.
PDF in [`AppConfig.allowedFileTypes`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/edit-image-app-config#properties) for Edit Image v2; PDFs are converted to PNG.
changes.action: Drop PDF from Edit Image `allowedFileTypes`, or expect PNG output.

changes.text: Enhanced [Editor Customization](../concepts/appconfig) concept guide with `assetCollection`, `showPageMargin`, and `showBleedArea` options, use cases, and examples.

[`CCEverywhere.BaseEditorAppConfig.assetCollection`](../../v4/shared/src/types/editor/app-config-types/interfaces/base-editor-app-config#properties) optional property (collection URN) for asset collection filtering in the Editor.
[`CCEverywhere.Callbacks.onIntentChange`](../../v4/shared/src/types/callbacks-types/interfaces/callbacks#properties) optional callback for intent change events in the Editor.
Performance improvements and bug fixes.

[`CCEverywhere.BaseEditorAppConfig.analyticsData`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties) (`hostAppTrigger`). See the [Analytics guide](../concepts/host-app-trigger).
Cancel events include optional `clientCtaLocation` and `workflowLoadCompleted` properties.
Various performance improvements and bug fixes.
[Firefly Custom Models](../concepts/generate-image-v2#custom-firefly-models) support in Generate Image V2 (Enterprise users only).

[`CCEverywhere.TextToImageAppConfig.appVersion`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties) option to opt in to Generate Image V2 with `appVersion: "2"` (default stays `"1"`).

v2 config options: [`thumbnailOptions`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties), [`editDropdownOptions`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties), [`publishConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties), [`fastModeConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties), and [`featureConfig`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties).
`pdfPrint` support in `allowedExportFileTypes` on `appConfig`.
[Concept Guide](../concepts/generate-image-v2) for Generate Image V2 and updated [Demo App](https://demo.expressembed.com/).
Loader CSS for frictionless experience.
Video `blob` and `base64` asset inputs for [`Editor.createWithAsset()`](../../v4/sdk/src/workflows/3p/editor-workflow/classes/editor-workflow#createwithasset).

Presigned [`URL`](../../v4/shared/src/types/asset-types/type-aliases/url-asset) as the [`datatype`](../../v4/shared/src/types/asset-types/enumerations/asset-data-type) for video [`asset`](../../v4/shared/src/types/asset-types/interfaces/asset-base) inputs in `createWithAsset()` is temporarily unsupported.
changes.action: Pass video as `blob` or `base64` until support returns.

changes.text: [`CCEverywhere.ExportConfig.EditFurtherIntent`](../../v4/shared/src/types/export-config-types/enumerations/edit-further-intent) intents `INSERT_OBJECT` and `REMOVE_OBJECT` in Edit Image.
[Asset](../../v4/shared/src/types/asset-types/) type documentation coverage.

[Embed SDK Developer Journey](../#embed-sdk-developer-journey) map and [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting/express-unavailable-error) guide for "Adobe Express is Unavailable" and "Missing Referrer Header" errors.
Various performance improvements and bug fixes.
[`CCEverywhere.TextToImagePublishParams.prompt`](../../v4/shared/src/types/publish-params-types/interfaces/text-to-image-publish-params) returns the prompt in `onPublish`.
[`CCEverywhere.appConfig.imageDimensions`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties) aspect ratio parameter in `createImageFromText()`.
[Error code guide](../concepts/error-handling) for managing errors.

[`CCEverywhere.appConfig.imageStyleReference`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties) and [`CCEverywhere.appConfig.imageCompositionReference`](../../v4/shared/src/types/module/app-config-types/interfaces/text-to-image-app-config#properties) in `createImageFromText()`.
Animate from Audio microphone input.
Enabled state for export buttons (`CCEverywhere.ExportConfig.ENABLED_BUTTON`).
`CCEverywhere.ExportConfig.DOWNLOAD_ALL` export option.
`CCEverywhere.createImageFromText.appConfig.imageDimensions` parameter.
Redesigned [SDK Reference](../../v4/) section and V3 to V4 [Migration Guide](../concepts/migration-v3-v4).
Reorganized docs: updated [Submission and Review](../review/) and [Quickstart](../quickstart/) guides, and new [Tutorials](../tutorials/) section.
`DocConfig` accepts `Blob` and `File` assets.
`CCEverywhere.terminate()`.
[z-index](../../reference/types/#containerconfig) support for the root container.
Callbacks move from `initialize()` to each call’s `appConfig`.
changes.action: Move callbacks from `initialize()` into the `appConfig` of each call.

changes.text: `createDesign` is now `editor.create` / `editor.createWithAsset`; `editDesign` is now `editor.edit`.
changes.action: Rename the calls. See the [migration guide](../concepts/migration-v3-v4).

changes.text: `openQuickAction` is replaced by one method per action.
`ExportOptions` changed shape.
Generate Image module: `createImageFromText`.
Edit Image module: `editImage`.
Delayed login.

releases.summary: LINE and note layouts ([CreateInputParams.canvasSize](../../reference/types/#canvasaspectid)) and template types ([CreateInputParams.templateType](../../reference/types/#templatetype)); QR Code and Caption Video quick actions.
`ExportButton.id` is required; `cta` variant renamed `accent`; Animate From Audio added; Reverse Video and Change Speed retired.
`initialize()` is async; browser support check; `terminate()`; Google One Tap sign-in.
Quick actions work logged out; bug fixes.
CDN bundle, welcome screen, and sign-out.
Configurable scrim and redirect URI; `appVersion` and `platformCategory` optional.
